messages:
olivia: Heads-up — seeing a short spike of 502/504s for /v1/generate in us-west-2 over the last 10m. Any dashboards or quick pointers? :eyes:
max: saw a blip on infra too. can you share a sample trace or time window you looked at?
olivia: window = now-10m to now. quick trace link: https://app.datadog.com/apm/trace/trace-abc123 (sample)
neel: FYI the most useful dash is Errors by Route (Grafana) — https://grafana.redwood.com/d/errs/errors-by-route?from=now-1h&to=now — filters -> route=/v1/generate, region=us-west-2
max: in datadog you can use this monitor query to sanity-check counts: `sum:last_5m:requests.errors{env:prod,route:/v1/generate}.as_count()`
mia: also check gateway timeouts dashboard — we saw similar pattern last month when nginx timeout got lowered during a rollout: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ops/gateway-timeouts
ash: (note) some of these 502s are correlated with upstream transient errors — look at upstream latency tag `upstream_resp_time` in traces
olivia: thanks — full trace shows a 504 at the gateway and the backend span had a long tail ~3.2s
max: if backend tail latency is causing gateway 504s we can either increase proxy timeout or tune the alert to ignore short bursts. what's current alert?
neel: current alert is a rate threshold: `error_rate > 1.0% over 5m` (prod, per-route). suggestion: change to `error_rate > 1.5% for 10m` OR add cardinality guard `by {api_key}` to avoid noisy keys spiking global rate
olivia: adding api_key makes sense, many clients retried aggressively and inflated the rate
ash: another approach is switch alert to anomaly detection on rolling baseline (Datadog anomaly) so short bursts don't immediately page
mia: oncall preference? small bursts during deploys are noisy. I can change monitor to reduce pages if we agree on params
max: ok if we add `api_key` guard + bump to 1.5% and extend to 10m that's a good start. can someone open a quick PR to update the monitor?
olivia: I can do the PR. will include rationale and rollback notes.
neel: also add a note in runbook: where to find traces/dash and when to escalate to eng-sre. runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/gateway-5xx
sre-bot: Incident checklist triggered: gateway-5xx-checklist — runbook recommended steps sent to #eng-oncall.
ash: one more tip — if you need low-noise debugging, query logs for `client_ip` and `user_agent` to find bots/retry loops. sample logs query: `service:gateway AND route:/v1/generate AND status:[500 TO 599] | group_by(client_ip)`
olivia: thx all — creating monitor PR now and will ping here when merged. :thumbsup:
